summary: Declare independent Core and Observer profile ownership.

ownershipContract.rootFiles: Explicit selected documents, not recursive traversal.
ownershipContract.sourceFacts: Each profile declares its own source roots and file/byte ceilings.
ownershipContract.sharedCode: A shared library can be referenced by multiple profiles only when each scope is explicit.

regression: Each profile uses only paths present in the package.
Each profile has a neutral self-eval with required paths scoped to its component.
Removing one optional component does not silently change another profile owner.
